Choose the ordinary-risk template rule on earlier pseudo-targets

Source: R/quiet.R
ec_quiet_select.Rd

Cross-validates every rule of a pre-specified grid on earlier surfaces treated as if they were the target ("pseudo-targets") and picks the rule with the lowest wing-shape error. Each pseudo-target's whole maturity block is left out of its template library, and with available_only = TRUE only templates that had expired by the pseudo-target's own valuation date are used. The real target's wings are never consulted.

Usage

ec_quiet_select(
  library,
  rules = ec_quiet_rules(),
  pseudo = NULL,
  pseudo_quiet = NULL,
  pseudo_min_dte = NULL,
  cutoff = NULL,
  available_only = TRUE,
  wing = NULL,
  common = TRUE,
  target = NULL
)

Arguments

library

An ec_quiet_library().

rules

Rule table from ec_quiet_rules().

pseudo

Optional surface identifiers of the pseudo-targets.

pseudo_quiet

Optional clock threshold: surfaces with \(A\) at or below it are pseudo-targets (used when pseudo is NULL; default: all surfaces with a known clock).

pseudo_min_dte

Optional minimum calendar days to expiry of a pseudo-target (applied on top of pseudo or pseudo_quiet). Shorter surfaces still serve as templates.

cutoff

Optional real-target valuation date: the library is first restricted to surfaces that expired at or before it.

available_only

Logical; restrict each pseudo-target's templates to those expired by its own valuation date (default TRUE). With FALSE, the whole (pre-cutoff) library minus the pseudo-target's maturity block is used.

wing

Moneyness band of the loss, in the library's moneyness (default c(0.04, 0.30) in log-moneyness, c(0.5, 3) standard deviations for a standardized library).

common

Logical; score all rules on a common set of nodes.

target

Optional list with date, expiry, atm_iv, k, and optionally tau for the real target; adds its predicted shape under every rule.

Value

An object of class ec_quiet_select: a list with scores (one row per rule: rule, rule columns, rmse, mae, rmse_target, n_targets, n_nodes, sorted best first), best (the selected row), detail (pseudo-target × rule × node: surface, rule, k, z, actual, shape, error), pseudo (the pseudo-target surfaces), and with target also target_shapes (the ec_quiet_shape() output for all rules, with a logical selected column).

Details

Loss. For each pseudo-target the predicted shape is compared with its realized shape at its own nodes with wing[1] <= |k| <= wing[2] (or |z| for a standardized library). Errors are in implied-volatility units (for shape = "ratio" the ratio error is scaled by the pseudo-target's at-the-money volatility). rmse pools all nodes; rmse_target averages the per-target RMSE.

Common nodes. Rules can differ in which nodes they can predict (a rule may select no template). With common = TRUE (default) every rule is scored on the same nodes — those every rule predicts.

Ties. Rules whose RMSE agrees to 10 significant digits are ordered by the stricter quietness threshold, then by their position in the grid.

References

Hanke, Schadner, Stöckl, and Weissensteiner (Working Paper), "Learning Before Scheduled Events: Prediction Markets, State Prices, and Option Valuation".

See also

ec_quiet_rules(), ec_quiet_shape().

Examples

set.seed(1)
nodes <- expand.grid(i = 1:20, k = seq(-0.3, 0.3, by = 0.05))
nodes$surface <- paste0("s", nodes$i)
nodes$date <- as.Date("2024-06-03") + 7 * (nodes$i - 1)
nodes$expiry <- nodes$date + 4
A <- c(0.01, 0.3, 0.02, 0.2, 0.01, 0.5, 0.03, 0.02, 0.4, 0.01,
       0.25, 0.02, 0.01, 0.35, 0.03, 0.02, 0.45, 0.01, 0.02, 0.3)
nodes$A <- A[nodes$i]
nodes$iv <- 0.5 + 0.8 * nodes$k^2 - ifelse(nodes$A > 0.1, 0.3 * nodes$k, 0) +
  rnorm(nrow(nodes), sd = 0.002)
lib <- ec_quiet_library(nodes)
sel <- ec_quiet_select(lib, pseudo_quiet = 0.02)
sel
#> <ec_quiet_select> 15 rules on 10 pseudo-targets (templates available at each pseudo-target, wing 0.04-0.3 log-moneyness)
#> Selected: p50 | any DTE | atm5  (RMSE 0.0024 on 108 nodes, 9 targets)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   rule                        rmse     mae n_targets n_nodes

#> 2 p50 | any DTE | recent5  0.00242 0.00197         9     108
#> 3 p50 | any DTE | all      0.00244 0.00197         9     108
#> 4 p50 | any DTE | recent10 0.00244 0.00197         9     108
